note: Fight cards for the archive's people in the Ethereal Realm (GM only), in the same tiers as Aetheris and Kaelmar. Owner decision, November 2026.

NPC-063.name: Eryndor the First Shard

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If Eryndor fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: First to Break Free
traits.text: Nothing can alter Eryndor's memory or rewrite what he is.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Eryndor makes two Crystal Strike attacks.

actions.name: Crystal Strike
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.

actions.name: Recollection (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 44 (8d10) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn as it remembers a life before the Cycle. Success: Half damage only.

legendary.name: Legendary Action Uses: 3
legendary.text: Immediately after another creature's turn, Eryndor can expend a use to take one of the following actions. He regains all expended uses at the start of each of his turns.

legendary.name: Strike
legendary.text: Eryndor makes one Crystal Strike attack.

legendary.name: Shift
legendary.text: Eryndor teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Restore (Costs 2 Uses)
legendary.text: One creature Eryndor can see within 60 feet regains 22 (4d10) Hit Points.

NPC-063.tactics: Almost never fights. He answers violence with a memory: he shows the attacker who they were before the Cycle, and waits. Only those who threaten what he remembers learn what he can do.

NPC-064.name: Sylas Vaerin
NPC-064.changes: His spells include Haste and Slow. Time Slip (3/Day): as a Reaction when Sylas is hit by an attack roll, the attacker rerolls and must use the new roll.
NPC-064.tactics: Stops time for a heartbeat and runs, shouting that he's nearly proved it.

NPC-065.name: Veyra the Unchained

traits.name: Unchained
traits.text: Veyra has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions, and spells such as Command and Geas have no effect on her.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.text: While Veyra wears no armor, her AC includes her Constitution modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Veyra makes one Greatsword attack and one Snapped Chain attack.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Snapped Chain
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Rage (1/Day)
bonus.text: For 1 minute, Veyra has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, and her weapon attacks deal an extra 2 damage.

bonus.name: Wild Radiance (1/Day)
bonus.text: For 1 minute, Veyra sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius, and each creature of her choice that ends its turn within 10 feet of her takes 3 Radiant damage.

NPC-065.gear: Broken Order plate, a snapped chain, a greatsword
NPC-065.tactics: Fights loud and grinning, until someone talks about oaths: then she goes for them. Spares anyone who has broken an oath of their own.

NPC-066.name: Kaelos "the Forgotten Star"

traits.name: Duergar Magic
traits.text: Once each per day, Kaelos can cast Enlarge/Reduce (on himself only) and Invisibility.

traits.name: His Guardian
traits.text: An Animated Armor (Monster Manual) built to his design goes everywhere with him.

actions.name: Star-Hammer
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Force damage.

reactions.name: Flash of Genius (3/Day)
reactions.text: Trigger: Kaelos or an ally within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. Response: Add 4 to the roll.

NPC-066.tactics: Measures the party before he fights them, and fights only to protect what he's building. Offers to build them something instead.

NPC-067.name: Lirien Ashborne

traits.name: Meant to Die (1/Day)
traits.text: When Lirien is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed, she drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.text: Lirien and allies within 10 feet of her add 4 to their saving throws while she doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Lirien makes two Reforged Sword attacks.

actions.name: Reforged Sword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

bonus.name: Vow of Enmity (1/Day)
bonus.text: For 1 minute, Lirien has Advantage on attack rolls against one creature she can see within 30 feet.

bonus.name: Divine Smite (2/Day)
bonus.text: Immediately after hitting a creature with a Reforged Sword attack, Lirien deals an extra 13 (3d8) Radiant damage to it.

NPC-067.tactics: Fights the one responsible, and only that one. Walks through anyone in the way, and doesn't stop until the debt is paid.

NPC-068.name: Master Ilythis
NPC-068.changes: Swim Speed 30 feet; they breathe air and water, and have Resistance to Acid damage. Their floating pages shield them: as a Reaction when hit by an attack roll, they add 5 to their AC against it.
NPC-068.tactics: Silent. Hands the attacker a page describing a history where the fight never happened, and in which the attacker lost.

NPC-070.name: Kyrra the Shadeborn

actions.name: Unmade Whisper
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Kyrra casts one of the following spells, using Charisma (spell save DC 14): At will: Druidcraft, Minor Illusion. 1/day each: Enlarge/Reduce, Faerie Fire, Fear, Speak with Dead.

reactions.name: The Unmade Answer (1/Day)
reactions.text: Trigger: Kyrra takes damage from a creature she can see. Response: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, the attacker. Failure: It has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

NPC-070.tactics: Would rather listen than fight. When she must, the Unmade fight with her: voices nobody remembers, screaming the attacker's name.

NPC-072.name: Elyndria the Echo

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.text: Elyndria can copy any sound she has heard. Wisdom (Insight) checks to tell the copy is false have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Borrowed Voice
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Psychic damage, spoken in the target's own voice.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Elyndria casts one of the following spells, using Charisma (spell save DC 15): At will: Minor Illusion. 2/day each: Mirror Image, Misty Step. 1/day: Hypnotic Pattern.

reactions.name: Mock (2/Day)
reactions.text: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet misses Elyndria with an attack roll. Response: It takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

NPC-072.languages: Understands Common; speaks only by mimicry
NPC-072.tactics: Mocks the party in their own voices. Fights to get free of anything that holds her, and leaves the moment the door is open.
